description: Step 1 of the fz-usm unification (plan 2026-07-05). Introduce a single registry table ConstructorEntry { name, arity: Arity(Fixed|Range), build: fn(&mut Types,&[Ty])->Ty } in resolve.rs. Migrate the 12 nullary scalar builtins (nil/bool/integer/float/cpointer/binary/atom/any/never/utf8/pid/ref) to consult it; DELETE enum Builtin, builtin_from_name, NameClass::Builtin (all private to resolve.rs, zero external callers -- grep-confirmed). classify_name looks up by name then checks the entry's declared arity (single generic 'expected N args, got M' diagnostic replacing the bespoke messages). BYTE-IDENTICAL Ty output for all 12 names -- pure mechanical concordant fold, the core '3 ways -> 1' reduction. SAFE, contained to resolve.rs. TDD: resolver-layer round-trip (resolve_type_expr_body) for each of the 12 names + one nullary-with-args negative test locking the uniform error text. No deps.
title: fz-usm registry: introduce ConstructorEntry table + migrate the 12 nullary scalars off Builtin/builtin_from_name
